instruction: A deposit of 1000 euro earns 5% compound interest per year. What is the amount after 2 years? Write the answer as a decimal rounded to two decimal places (always exactly two digits after the point). Compute it with the bash tool (python3 -c). Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory (for example with bash: echo 42 > answer.txt).
